tasks.description: The dashboard should provide a centralized location for reports. It should be accessible by authorized users. The dashboard's layout and design are to be determined.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the correct permissions, when they navigate to the dashboard, then they can view the available reports.

tasks.description: The layout of the dashboard should be determined based on user needs and available reports. It should be intuitive and easy to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they view the dashboard, then the layout is consistent and easy to navigate.

tasks.description: The dashboard should be able to display and integrate with existing reports. This may involve creating APIs or data connectors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report, when it is added to the dashboard, then the report data is correctly displayed.
